description: Technical indicator values for any public ticker, with no chart: stocks, ETFs, indices, crypto, FX and futures. Use it for indicator numbers or a technical summary, such as the RSI of NVDA. Pass symbol as a Yahoo-style ticker (AAPL, EUR/USD, BTC-USD, GOLD); turn a company name into its ticker first. Optional: timeframe (5m, 15m, 1h, 4h, 1d, 1w; 1d default), indicators (any of 12; all by default), periods, lengths (SMA and EMA; 20, 50 and 200 by default), series_length, and detail full for recent values of each. Returns latest and previous values, a one-line reading of each, its position against one named reference line, a count of those positions, the source, as-of time and data delay. A currency pair is the ECB daily close-only reference rate, so its range indicators are skipped. To show a chart, use chart. The count is not a buy or sell rating. Not financial advice.

detail.description: compact (default) returns the latest and previous values and a reading of each indicator; full also returns the last 5 values of each. series_length sets that count either way.

indicators.description: Any of sma, ema, rsi, macd, bollinger, atr, stochastic, vwap, adx, cci, williams_r, obv. All 12 when omitted.

lengths.description: SMA and EMA lengths to return, each its own entry, shortest first, such as [50, 200]. Overrides periods.sma and periods.ema. 20, 50, 200 when omitted and periods sets no sma or ema length.

periods.description: Lookback per indicator, in bars, such as {"sma": 50}. A period applies only when its indicator is in indicators. MACD stays 12, 26, 9, and VWAP and OBV have no length, so none has an entry.

adx.description: 14 bars by default, at most 100. Used only when adx is in indicators; ignored otherwise.

atr.description: 14 bars by default, at most 100. Used only when atr is in indicators; ignored otherwise.

bollinger.description: 20 bars by default, at most 100. Used only when bollinger is in indicators; ignored otherwise.

cci.description: 20 bars by default, at most 100. Used only when cci is in indicators; ignored otherwise.

ema.description: 20 bars by default, at most 200. Used only when ema is in indicators; ignored otherwise.

rsi.description: 14 bars by default, at most 100. Used only when rsi is in indicators; ignored otherwise.

sma.description: 20 bars by default, at most 200. Used only when sma is in indicators; ignored otherwise.

stochastic.description: 14 bars by default, at most 100. Used only when stochastic is in indicators; ignored otherwise.

williams_r.description: 14 bars by default, at most 100. Used only when williams_r is in indicators; ignored otherwise.

series_length.description: How many recent values to return per indicator, oldest first. None by default; 5 when detail is full.

symbol.description: Yahoo-style ticker, such as "AAPL". Also accepted: BRK-B, EUR/USD or EURUSD, BTC-USD, BTC/USDT or PEPEUSDT (any coin against USD), GOLD (GC=F), SPX. Turn a company name into its ticker first: Apple is AAPL.

name: get_indicators

asOf.description: ISO 8601 UTC time of the last bar, or of the call when status is not ok

bars.description: Bars the values were calculated from. 0 when status is not ok.

changePercent.description: Percent change from the previous close to the last close. null when status is not ok.

currency.description: Price currency code from the source, such as USD. Empty when the source gives none.

delay.description: How current the prices are: the source's delay and this service's cache time. Empty when no prices were read.

error.description: Present when status is not ok

hint.description: The next step: what to change or tell the user

anchor.description: vwap only: the open time of the first bar summed. The session start on 5m, 15m, 1h and 4h; the first loaded bar on 1d and 1w.

latest.description: Latest values of the study, in the price currency except RSI, stochastic and ADX (0 to 100), Williams %R (0 to -100), CCI (no fixed range) and OBV (volume)

value.description: sma, ema, rsi, atr, vwap, cci, williams_r and obv value

params.description: Settings used for the study. Empty for vwap and obv.

deviations.description: Bollinger Band width in standard deviations

position.description: Where the indicator sits against its one reference line, named in reference: the close against sma, ema, vwap and the Bollinger middle; RSI and %K against 50; CCI against 0; Williams %R against -50; MACD against its signal line; +DI against -DI. none for atr and obv.

anyOf.description: One past value of the study, with the open time of its bar

value.description: sma, ema, rsi, atr, vwap, cci, williams_r and obv value

previous.description: The value on the bar before the latest, with its time. null when the earlier bars are too few.

reading.description: One plain line: the latest value against its usual reference level or line (RSI against 30 and 70, MACD against its signal line and zero, the close against each average) and the previous value. Positions, not signals.

reference.description: What position compares, such as "%K against 50". Empty for atr and obv.

series.description: Recent values, oldest first. Empty unless series_length is set or detail is full; shorter than series_length when the earlier bars are too few for the study.

items.description: One past value of the study, with the open time of its bar

value.description: sma, ema, rsi, atr, vwap, cci, williams_r and obv value

lastClose.description: Last close in the price currency. null when status is not ok.

notice.description: Not-financial-advice notice. Show it with the values.

read.description: Plain-language description of the values. Not financial advice. Empty when status is not ok.

skipped.description: Requested indicators that could not be calculated

length.description: The sma or ema length skipped, when several were asked for

source.description: Price source: Yahoo Finance, Coinbase, or ECB reference rates through Frankfurter. Empty, or the failing source, when status is not ok.

status.description: ok, or why there are no values; error.hint then says what to do next

summary.description: How many readings sit above, below or on their reference line. A count of positions, not a buy or sell rating.

symbol.description: Symbol as read, such as AAPL, EUR/USD, BTC-USD or GC=F

title: Indicator values
